Reference

XP requirements

Every level's cost on both ladders. Normal levels run on the player XP column up to each promotion's cap; past the cap, a season's bless ladder takes over with its own XP pool, and the level you see is the cap plus your bless level. Promote in the next season and the numbers you already passed become ordinary levels again.

How the game counts it

Player.Level = BaseLevel + bless level. A level above your promotion's base cap is a season level (IsSeasonLevel: level > base cap). The bless ladder opens only when you hold the top sub-rank of the season's promotion and stand at its cap; it runs to the bless limit in system_level_limit for that promotion. Normal XP is level_exp column 1, stored as the total from level 0; bless XP is level_bless, stored as the total per promotion family. The per-level numbers below are the differences.
